wu: Simon Says with house parts: 'Simon says touch the kitchen!' 'Simon says point to the bedroom!' Students jump and say the room name when correct.
wuAlt: Flashcard Race: Show room flashcards, students race to touch the whiteboard and say the name.
Find the Room: Call out a room, students find the matching picture card on their table.
pres: Use a big house poster to show rooms. Teacher says: 'This is a house. A house has rooms. This is the kitchen. This is the bedroom. This is the bathroom.' Ask: 'Where is mummy?' Students point and say: 'She is in the kitchen.'
presAlt: Storytime: Read 'My House' story, point to rooms. Ask: 'Where is the cat?' Students answer: 'In the bedroom.'
TPR Tour: Walk around the room, pretend to cook in 'kitchen', sleep in 'bedroom', wash in 'bathroom', say sentences.
prac: Make a mini-book: Students fold paper into 4 sections. Draw kitchen, bedroom, bathroom, living room. Write 'There is a kitchen' etc. Read to partner: 'This is my house. There is a kitchen.'
pracAlt: House Plan Match: Give house plan with rooms blank. Students listen: 'There is a bedroom' and draw it in the right place.
Find and Stick: Students have room stickers. Teacher says: 'Put the kitchen in the house.' Students stick and say: 'There is a kitchen.'
ls: Listen to a house tour audio: 'Look! This is the kitchen. Mummy is in the kitchen.' Students point to the kitchen on their house poster. Check if they point correctly.
re: Room Jump: Call out a room, students jump to the flashcard on the floor. Say: 'I jump to the bedroom!'
prod: My House Show and Tell: Students use their mini-book. Stand up, point to a room, say: 'This is my house. There is a bedroom. Mummy is in the bedroom.'
rw: Trace and Write: Students trace sentences: 'There is a kitchen.' 'There is a bedroom.' Then copy them. Draw a picture next to each sentence.
st: Sing 'The House Song' with actions. Goodbye routine: Goodbye Song + sticker chart + high-five line.
g: Students have bingo cards with room pictures. Teacher calls out a room, students cover it.
Hide a teddy in a room. Students ask: 'Where is Teddy?' Teacher answers: 'He is in the kitchen.'
Students match room pictures and words. Say: 'Kitchen, kitchen.'
Students put house puzzle together. Say: 'This is the bedroom.'
Teacher acts cooking, students guess: 'It is the kitchen!'
diff: Fast finishers: Draw an extra room (e.g. garden) and write: 'There is a garden.'
Support: Use word bank with room names to copy from.
hw: Find 5 house pictures in magazines, cut them out, stick on paper, label: 'kitchen', 'bedroom' etc.
Draw your house, write 3 sentences: 'There is a kitchen.' 'There is a bedroom.'
Ask family: 'Where is Daddy?' Write: 'He is in the living room.'
tip: Use TPR to reinforce prepositions (in, on) with room objects, e.g. 'Put the spoon in the kitchen.'
